subject.title: fix(line): dripping inbound media downloads hang past setup timeout

question: Should LINE inbound media use the proposed fixed 120-second fail-closed body deadline for all existing installations?
rationale: Source and loopback tests support adding a body deadline, but repository evidence cannot determine whether 120 seconds safely covers valid production LINE downloads for existing users.

options.title: Retain 120 seconds after proof
options.body: Accept the sibling-aligned ceiling once a redacted real LINE run demonstrates ordinary media success and bounded stalled-body failure.

options.title: Choose a different body budget
options.body: Request a more generous or otherwise justified LINE-specific ceiling if production media characteristics make 120 seconds too aggressive.

recommendation.title: Retain 120 seconds after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the sibling-aligned ceiling once a redacted real LINE run demonstrates ordinary media success and bounded stalled-body failure.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available recent LINE runtime-history signal, though download-specific ownership remains uncertain.
